findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 163 and 174 only multiply x i by powers of -1. These powers are signs; Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/NegOnePow.lean:109 likewise handles powers of -1 under [Ring R].
findings.fix: Generalize both signatures to [Ring R]; use power identities and distributivity instead of commutative ring normalization.
findings.issue: Both sum_range_neg_one_pow_sub_mul and sum_range_succ_neg_one_pow_sub_mul unnecessarily require [CommRing R], excluding noncommutative rings from elementary sign identities.

findings.evidence: Mathlib/Algebra/Polynomial/Basic.lean:87 works under [Semiring R]; X_mul_monomial at line 550 states X * monomial n r = monomial (n + 1) r. No products between arbitrary coefficients are needed.
findings.fix: Weaken the signature to [Semiring R] and prove the identity using monomial additivity, distributivity, and X_mul_monomial.
findings.issue: sum_range_monomial_add_monomial_eq_of_eq_add unnecessarily requires [CommSemiring R], restricting a coefficientwise additive identity.

summary: Three new algebraic lemmas impose unnecessary commutativity assumptions.
